top_signals.title: Life Expectancy Must Be Factored in Retirement: Bitterly
top_signals.summary: Kristen Bitterly, head of global Wealth at Work at Citi, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how the increase in life expectancy is changing how people plan for retirement. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: The Modern Attack Chain: Rethinking Google Workspace Security in the Age of AI
top_signals.summary: Google Workspace attacks do not always begin with phishing. Stolen OAuth tokens can provide another path into Gmail, Drive, and connected systems. Material Security explains why organizations need defenses that cover the entire Workspace attack chain. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
